feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 October 2026 4:57pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 22 October 2026 at 4:55pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There is a Gale warning in operation.


##Synopsis##

Very weak ridge of high pressure at first will decline, deep low pressure will move eastwards through the English Channel tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

South 3 or 4 backing and increasing east 5 or 6 this evening, then northeast 5 to 7 tonight. Backing northwest 7 or gale 8 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate or rough later today and tonight.


##Weather##

Fair, then heavy rain tonight, showers tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 7 or gale 8, decreasing west or northwest 5 to 7 tomorrow evening. Backing west or southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Saturday, increasing south 7 to severe gale 9 Saturday morning then veering southwest in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling moderate overnight into Saturday, building rough or very rough by late Saturday morning.


##Weather##

Rain or showers.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain, otherwise good.
